sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: The operations team records each service incident in the shared log. The incident commander coordinates response and customer updates. The reviewer confirms that the handoff is recorded.

sections.heading: Acknowledgement
sections.text: A Sev 2 incident should be acknowledged within 60 minutes. The on-call engineer posts the first status update.

sections.heading: Escalation
sections.text: If the on-call engineer cannot respond, the incident commander takes ownership and records the handoff in the incident log.

sections.heading: Legal notice
sections.text: This synthetic handbook is for demonstration only and does not replace an organization's incident policy.

sections.heading: Known details

sections.heading: Sign-off
sections.text: The incident commander approves the final customer-facing update.
